map.碳化系数 k=1.0mm/√a（普通 C30 室外），t=20a：x=k·√t=: With a carbonation coefficient k = 1.0 mm/√a (ordinary C30 outdoors) and t = 20 a: x = k·√t = 1.0 × √20 ≈ 4.5 mm. With a 25 mm cover the bar is not reached in the near term, but members with thin cover need close attention.
map.水胶比（越大 k 越大）、掺合料（粉煤灰/矿粉降低孔隙率减小 k）、养护与湿度；: The water-binder ratio (larger ratio means larger k), admixtures (fly ash and slag reduce porosity and lower k), and curing and humidity. Indoors k is far smaller than in alternating wet-dry exposure.
map.碳化到钢筋就一定会锈吗？: Does carbonation reaching the bar always mean it corrodes?
map.碳化使孔液 pH 下降、钝化膜破坏，但是否锈蚀还取决于湿度与氯离子；可达钢筋面是: Carbonation lowers the pore solution pH and breaks down the passive film, but whether corrosion occurs also depends on moisture and chlorides. Reaching the bar surface is the risk threshold, not a certainty.
map.怎么实测碳化深度？: How is carbonation depth measured on site?
map.钻芯或断面喷酚酞试剂，未碳化区变红、碳化区不变色，量取变色边界到表面距离即为碳化: Take a core or spray phenolphthalein on a fresh section: the uncarbonated zone turns pink while the carbonated zone does not, and the distance from the colour boundary to the surface is the carbonation depth.
map.📚 深度解析：K 值取值、算例与规范对应: 📚 Deep dive: K values, worked examples, and code correspondence
map.碳化深度按平方根规律 x = K·√t 增长：时间增至 4 倍，深度只增至 2: Carbonation depth follows the square-root law x = K·√t: quadrupling the time only doubles the depth. So "doubling the service life" is not "doubling the carbonation depth" - pay attention to the order of magnitude of K.

map.二、碳化速度系数 K 的经验取值: 2. Empirical values of the carbonation rate coefficient K
map.下表为工程经验参考区间（非规范强制值），实际应以同配合比、同环境的历史检测数据反: The table gives empirical engineering ranges (not mandatory code values). In practice, back-calculate K from historical measurements for the same mix and exposure; without measured data, use the mid-range value and run a sensitivity check.
map.C20–C25 取上限，C40 以上取下限；养护充分取下限: Use the upper bound for C20-C25 and the lower bound above C40; use the lower bound with adequate curing
map.碳化最快区间，无实测时取 2.5: Fastest carbonation range; use 2.5 without measurements
map.孔隙水饱和阻碍 CO₂ 扩散，碳化反而慢: Saturated pore water hinders CO₂ diffusion, so carbonation is slower
map.工业区、隧道、车库等 CO₂ 浓度高处取上限: Use the upper bound where CO₂ concentration is high, such as industrial areas, tunnels and garages

map.这说明保护层从 20 mm 增至 25 mm（仅 5 mm），到达钢筋的时间从: Moving from 20 mm to 25 mm of cover (just 5 mm) extends the time to reach the rebar from 100 to 156 years - cover thickness has far more leverage on durability than raising the strength grade, which is why codes treat cover as a mandatory detailing requirement.

map.：按环境类别（I–V 类）与设计使用年限规定最大水胶比、最低强度等级与保护层厚度: : specifies the maximum water-binder ratio, minimum strength grade and cover thickness by exposure class (I-V) and design service life; the K values here are a simplified engineering use of the empirical formulas/parameters in its appendix.

map.：规定受力钢筋的保护层最小厚度（板 15 mm、梁柱 20–25 mm、基础 4: : specifies the minimum cover for load-bearing reinforcement (slabs 15 mm, beams/columns 20-25 mm, foundations 40 mm, etc., adjusted by exposure class); it is the source of c when back-calculating the years to reach the rebar.
map.既有结构评估可参考现场实测碳化深度（酚酞酒精溶液滴定法）：先测得 x 与已知 t: For existing structures, use the carbonation depth measured on site (phenolphthalein-alcohol titration): measure x at a known t, back-calculate K = x / √t, then extrapolate the remaining service life with this tool - more reliable than applying an empirical K directly.
map.平方根规律假设 CO₂ 扩散为控制环节，适用于无裂缝、无严重施工缺陷的一般构件；: The square-root law assumes CO₂ diffusion is rate-controlling and applies to ordinary members free of cracks and major construction defects; carbonation accelerates markedly at through-cracks, which this model does not cover.
map.相对湿度 60%–75% 时碳化最快；长期水下或完全干燥环境 K 明显偏小，不宜: Carbonation is fastest at 60%-75% relative humidity; in permanently submerged or fully dry conditions K is markedly smaller, so outdoor values should not be applied directly.
map.掺大量矿物掺合料（粉煤灰、矿渣）会降低早期抗碳化能力，K 应取经验区间上限并辅以: Large amounts of mineral admixtures (fly ash, slag) reduce early carbonation resistance; use the upper bound of the empirical range and verify by measurement.
map.本工具为经验估算，不替代现场检测与耐久性专项评定；涉及设计使用年限的责任判定应以: This tool is an empirical estimate and does not replace on-site testing or a dedicated durability assessment; responsibility decisions about design service life should follow the codes and inspection reports.
